narrative: Gaunt's roll is open in one hand. The other hand is at his face. The window looks on the close, and the close is not listening. No glass, no throne, no second person. He does not force the next clause into a shape the mouth will not hold. The roll stays open. He does not write a new word on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Conned the speech aloud, and did not call it finished.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on part in Gaunt at the window
